items.title: "Pete" Ferdinand Valentine Interview, 1960-06-24
items.q: Yeah, Morris French was talking about Vance on.

ctx.x: Morris French was talking about him.

Yeah, Morris French was talking about Vance on. Uh-huh. He's good. Very good. Oh yeah, he could bring it down to a string bass. Uh-huh. Yeah, he could bring it down to a string. And you got his, uh, let's see, you got a guy named George Treacher. He died, he used to play, play a circling bass. He died, he's pretty good too, but Vance, Vance was good. Had one by the name of Bari Cole. Oh, I thought we all can call all of them, but there were no few of them.
What did they call the brass band? A brass, huh? What was the name of the band?
